race.comment: ROLL THE ACES (9) settled handy the went to the front and closed the race off well to win for the second time in a row last start over 1740m at this track, getting there by 9 metres. Can settle just behind them and wait on the sprint lane. Tackles a similar assignment and he can grab another win. MITTYS THREE ACES NZ (2) stayed out of the early speed battle from a wide gate on the front line last start and failed to make an impact, finishing 21 metres from the winner in eighth at this track over 1740m. Likely to get all the favours from this better draw. Meets a similar quality field and is good enough to take out a race like this. TROUBLE IN HEAVEN (8) is heading the right way, improving last time out to finish third at this track over 1740m. Genuine threat. CRIMSON ROCK NZ (1) has drawn to advantage and should give backers a great sight.
